prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic vertical bedroom selfie for an approved adult, preserving the prone bed pose, white ribbed tank top and lounge shorts, socks, floral pillows, and daylight.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long straight dark-brown hair, fair complexion and rosy cheeks, gentle smile and direct eye contact, wearing a white ribbed tank top, white ruffled lounge shorts, and white crew socks.
prompt.composition_elements: High-angle medium-shot selfie with the subject lying comfortably prone on a rumpled white bed, knees bent upward and ankles crossed, left arm extended for the selfie and head on a pillow. Include two windows with white frames and horizontal blinds, side table with skincare products, pink mug, small plant, and tissues. Vertical 9:16.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural soft daylight from the windows, gentle shadows, bright cozy domestic atmosphere, realistic bedding and skin texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone selfie, vertical 9:16, high-angle perspective, sharp subject with softly detailed background, natural handheld realism.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 high-angle bedroom selfie of an approved adult woman with long straight dark-brown hair, fair complexion and rosy cheeks, lying comfortably prone on a rumpled white bed with knees bent upward and ankles crossed, head resting on a pillow and left arm extended for the selfie. She wears a white ribbed tank top, white ruffled lounge shorts, and white crew socks. Two windows with white frames and horizontal blinds, side table with skincare products, pink mug, small plant, and tissues. Natural soft daylight, gentle shadows, cozy casual domestic atmosphere, realistic texture.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, exposed intimate areas, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, warped phone, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, invented text

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve identity consistency, hair, secure outfit, pose, bedding, room props, and lighting. Clothing, bedding, and decor may be replaced while maintaining the same cozy bedroom composition. Do not invent typography or logos.
